ask: can u make a poll for these 4 weekends and lock the one w enough yeses
sentence: A group poll where members tap the dates they can do, and anyone can lock the leading date once it has yeses from a majority of the chat.
use_when: a group needs to pick one date from a short list of weekends
people want to mark which dates they can make
the group wants to lock a date only after most members agree
planning an outing or event with several candidate dates
dont_use_when: the group needs to pick a time of day or a time slot grid
the choice is not about dates, such as picking a place or food
you need ranked or scored votes rather than simple yes
you need a one-on-one scheduling with a single person
